title: escalated-long-poll-retry-throttle-and-hosted-5xx-degradation
creator: Ava Chen
description: High-severity customer escalations reporting widespread 5xx and timeouts for long-poll / streaming endpoints under spike load. Multiple customers reported prolonged tail latency (20-60s) followed by 502/504 and then a flood of client retries that amplified the outage. This ticket coordinates the postmortem fixes: short-term mitigations, a targeted runtime patch, SDK guidance, and follow-up reliability work to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2025-01-14 10:05 UTC: First customer alert (analytics vendor) reported repeated 504 on long-poll subscriptions. 2025-01-14 10:20 UTC: Oncall triage — observed regional spike in long-lived connections to /v1/stream and /v1/poll. 2025-01-14 10:45 UTC: Edge proxy queue depth increases and some worker pods hit socket write timeouts. 2025-01-14 11:15 UTC: Temporary mitigation deployed — soft-quarantine of highest-volume tenants and temporary broker admission caps. 2025-01-15: Investigation and targeted fixes developed; patch deployed to staging and under review for prod rollout.
investigation_notes: Key signals: (1) sudden rise in concurrent long-poll connections from a small subset of tenants; (2) host-level proxy buffers filled when upstream worker response stalls; (3) SDK auto-retry (v0.7.2) behavior re-sent non-idempotent streaming requests after client-side timeouts; (4) runtime eviction of KV-cache entries during memory pressure caused latent cold starts and a cascade of 502s when many requests re-entered slowpath. Traces show repeated identical request hashes from same tenant within short windows, indicating amplified retries rather than fresh user traffic.
root_cause: Three-factor cascade: (A) tenant workload pattern (many simultaneous long-poll connections) plus an upstream transient stall; (B) edge/proxy admission allowed unbounded long-lived connections leading to buffer exhaustion and backpressure; (C) client SDK auto-retries for streaming/poll endpoints that were not labeled idempotent, causing retry amplification and bounding the system into a 5xx wave.
mitigation: Short-term: (1) deploy soft caps on concurrent long-poll per-tenant at the edge (circuit-breaker), (2) add server-side header X-Request-Idempotency: none to signal SDKs to avoid automatic retries for streaming endpoints, (3) increase proxy write buffers and ingress queue hysteresis, (4) emergency customer comms and routing high-volume tenants to dedicated capacity where available.
code_changes: Runtime: admission controller to limit inflight long-poll connections per tenant and an early fast-fail for non-progressing streams. Edge: connection queue hysteresis and keepalive tuning. SDK guidance: disable auto-retry for streaming endpoints by default and expose a bounded-retry policy opt-in for idempotent poll calls. See PRs for details.
customer_communication: Initial customer-facing status updates sent 2025-01-14 12:00 UTC with mitigation actions and ETA for fix. Follow-up technical debrief scheduled with impacted accounts 2025-01-17. Provided workaround: toggle to dedicated endpoints and SDK guidance to disable retries for streaming/polling.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Edge enforces per-tenant long-poll cap and prevents queue saturation in controlled load tests. 2) SDK default changed so streaming calls are not auto-retried; tests added to ensure no retry amplification. 3) Runtime patch reduces 5xx spike rate by >=90% in synthetic replay of incident traffic. 4) Dashboards alert on long-poll inflight threshold and trigger runbook automatically.
next_steps: Merge and roll runtime PR with staged canary to us-west then global rollout
Coordinate SDK release (v0.7.3) with release notes clearly calling out behavioral change
Add automated chaos test for long-poll storms in CI
